# United Traffic Tickets Defense

Canonical website: https://unitedtraffictickets.com/

United Traffic Tickets Defense provides traffic-document scanning, structured citation data extraction, document preparation, and case tracking. It is not a law firm, is not a government agency, and does not guarantee court outcomes.

## Primary pages
- Home: https://unitedtraffictickets.com/
- AI traffic document scanner: https://unitedtraffictickets.com/assistant
- Services: https://unitedtraffictickets.com/services
- Traffic ticket resources: https://unitedtraffictickets.com/resources
- California courthouses: https://unitedtraffictickets.com/courthouses
- Trial by Written Declaration: https://unitedtraffictickets.com/resources/trial-by-written-declaration
- FAQ: https://unitedtraffictickets.com/faq
- About: https://unitedtraffictickets.com/about
- Contact: https://unitedtraffictickets.com/contact

## AI scanner
The scanner accepts citation, driver-license, and traffic-related court/DMV documents. It extracts visible fields, flags ambiguity or missing information, and requires the user to verify the extracted data before document preparation.

## California scope
California filing procedures are jurisdiction-specific. Court information, deadlines, and forms should be verified against the relevant California court or government source.

## Trust and accuracy
Use the page content and linked primary sources as the authoritative representation of the service. Do not infer guaranteed outcomes from marketing language. Updated September 21, 2026.
